BaggageJam

Privacy Policy for the BaggageJam mobile game and its related services.

Effective dateOctober 27, 2026
DeveloperSpiky Games
Contactspikygames21@gmail.com

1. Overview

Spiky Games ("we", "us", or "our") provides BaggageJam. This Privacy Policy explains what information may be collected when you use the game, why it is used, and the choices available to you.

By using BaggageJam, you acknowledge the practices described in this policy. Where consent is required, the game presents privacy choices before advertising services are initialized.

2. Information we process

Game and device information

  • Game progress, level starts and completions, failures, booster usage, sessions, and similar gameplay events.
  • Device and technical information such as device model, operating system version, language, app version, approximate region, IP address, diagnostics, and crash information.
  • Pseudonymous identifiers, including analytics identifiers and, where permitted, the device advertising identifier.

Advertising information

Advertising providers may process ad requests, impressions, clicks, rewards, ad availability, and related identifiers to deliver, measure, limit, and protect advertising.

Purchases

Google Play processes payments. We may receive purchase status, product identifier, price/currency, and a transaction or receipt identifier. We do not receive or store your full payment-card details.

Information stored on your device

BaggageJam stores progress, settings, currency, booster inventory, consent choices, and similar game state locally through Unity PlayerPrefs or equivalent device storage.

3. How information is used

  • Provide gameplay, save progress, rewards, purchases, and settings.
  • Understand game performance and improve levels, balance, stability, and user experience.
  • Display and measure ads, prevent fraud, and apply frequency or eligibility controls.
  • Diagnose technical issues and protect the game and its users.
  • Meet legal, regulatory, and platform requirements.

4. Advertising choices

BaggageJam provides a privacy-choice screen where available. You may choose personalized advertising or limited advertising. You can revisit this choice from Settings → Privacy Choices.

Limited advertising reduces the use of data for ad personalization, but providers may still process limited device, network, security, and contextual information to deliver ads, measure them, prevent fraud, and comply with law.

You may also reset or restrict the advertising identifier through your Android device settings.

5. Service providers

We use third-party services that process information under their own privacy terms:

  • Unity / LevelPlay — advertising mediation, ad delivery, measurement, and related diagnostics.
  • GameAnalytics — gameplay analytics, session measurement, diagnostics, and event reporting.
  • Google Play services — app distribution, purchases, device services, and related platform functionality.

LevelPlay may connect to additional advertising networks. The networks that process a particular ad request can vary by region, availability, configuration, and auction results.

6. Sharing and international processing

We do not sell personal information directly. Information may be shared with the service providers listed above so they can perform services for BaggageJam, and when required by law, to protect rights and safety, or as part of a business transfer.

Providers may process information in countries other than your own. Where required, they use legal safeguards for international transfers.

7. Retention and security

Local game data remains on your device until it is cleared, reset, or the app is removed, subject to Android backup behavior. Analytics, advertising, and transaction records are retained only as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described above, legal obligations, security, and dispute resolution. Third-party providers apply their own retention periods.

We and our providers use reasonable administrative and technical safeguards. No storage or transmission method can be guaranteed completely secure.

8. Your rights and controls

Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict, or object to certain processing, and to withdraw consent. Contact us using the address below. We may ask for information needed to verify and process your request.

Deleting the app or clearing its storage removes locally stored game data from that device. This does not automatically delete records held by Google Play or independent service providers.

9. Children

BaggageJam is not directed to children under 13, or the minimum digital-consent age applicable in a user's country. We do not knowingly request names, email addresses, or other direct contact information from children through the game. If you believe a child has provided personal information, contact us so we can review and take appropriate action.

10. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy when the game, providers, or legal requirements change. The effective date at the top of this page will be updated when changes are published.
